sentence_stem: Only after the vote was counted
correct_completion: did the committee announce the result.
full_sentence: Only after the vote was counted did the committee announce the result.
acceptable_variants: did the chairperson publish the outcome.
did the officials declare the winner.

options.why_wrong: After 'only after' at the start, the auxiliary must come before the subject, so this normal word order is incorrect.

options.text: the committee would announce the result.
options.why_wrong: No inversion follows 'only after', and 'would' changes the meaning to a hypothetical future.

options.text: did the committee announce the result.
the result was announced by the committee.
options.why_wrong: This passive form ignores the required inversion after the initial 'only after' phrase.

explanation: When a sentence begins with 'only after', the auxiliary verb comes before the subject in the main clause.
translation: Пробные голоса были подсчитаны только после этого, и тогда комитет объявил результат.
